title_zh: 排练前报告线缆与夹子问题

scenario.label_zh: 排练通道的线缆夹子报修
scenario.goal_zh: 指出绊倒与夹子断裂的担忧并约定先请舞台人员处理

context_zh: 成年舞者 Freya 与舞台助理 Cole 在排练开始前查看一条横过通道的松动线缆。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Freya
sentences.text: Someone could stumble over this cable. It’s coming out of the clip.

sentences.speaker: Cole
sentences.text: The clip is bent. I’m worried it might snap if I force it shut.

sentences.speaker: Freya
sentences.text: Then let’s not force it. Could the stage crew replace it and sort out the cable before we start?

sentences.speaker: Cole
sentences.text: I’ll ask them now. Please keep the group out of this passage while they check it.

sentences.speaker: Freya
sentences.text: I will. We’ll wait in the rehearsal room until they tell us the passage is ready.
